topics.title: Baustellen und Umleitungen
topics.englishContext: During summer, many cities carry out roadworks and maintenance. Bus and tram routes may change temporarily, and everyday journeys can take longer than usual.

interestingFacts.de: Viele größere Bauarbeiten werden in die Ferienzeit gelegt, weil dann weniger Pendler und Schülerinnen und Schüler unterwegs sind. Trotzdem können Umleitungen den Nahverkehr deutlich verändern.
interestingFacts.en: Major construction work is often scheduled during school holidays because fewer commuters and students are travelling. Even so, diversions can significantly affect local transport.

topics.title: Eine Pause in der Eisdiele
topics.englishTitle: A break at the ice-cream shop
topics.englishContext: On warm days, ice-cream shops become popular meeting places. People choose between classic and unusual flavours and order their ice cream in a cone or cup.

interestingFacts.de: Viele Eisdielen in Deutschland werden von italienischen Familien geführt. Einige schließen im Winter vollständig und öffnen erst wieder im Frühjahr.
interestingFacts.en: Many ice-cream shops in Germany are run by Italian families. Some close completely during winter and reopen in spring.

topics.title: Pflanzen während des Urlaubs
topics.englishTitle: Looking after plants during a holiday
topics.englishContext: Indoor and balcony plants often need more water during summer. People who travel may ask friends or neighbours to water them and explain how often this should be done.

interestingFacts.de: Das Gießen von Pflanzen ist eine typische kleine Nachbarschaftshilfe während der Urlaubszeit. Häufig übernimmt man später eine ähnliche Aufgabe als Gegenleistung.
interestingFacts.en: Watering plants is a common small favour between neighbours during the holiday season. The favour is often returned later in a similar situation.

topics.title: Kino unter freiem Himmel
topics.englishContext: During summer, many cities show films outdoors. These events usually begin after sunset and may take place in parks, courtyards or unusual public spaces.

interestingFacts.de: Open-Air-Kinos finden häufig in Parks, Innenhöfen, Schwimmbädern oder historischen Gebäuden statt. Auch an warmen Tagen kann es am späten Abend kühl werden.
interestingFacts.en: Open-air cinemas are often hosted in parks, courtyards, swimming pools or historic locations. Even after a warm day, temperatures can drop later in the evening.
